params.name: match[]
params.description: Series selector argument used to scope metric discovery.

params.name: search[]
params.description: One or more search terms matched against metric names (OR logic).

params.name: fuzz_threshold
params.description: Fuzzy threshold in the range 0-100. A value of 0 is the lowest fuzzy threshold.

params.name: fuzz_alg
params.description: Fuzzy algorithm. Supported values are subsequence (default) and jarowinkler.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Sort mode. Supported values are alpha and score.

params.name: sort_dir
params.description: Sort direction. Only valid with sort_by=alpha. Supported values are asc and dsc.

params.name: include_score
params.description: Include the relevance score in each result.

params.name: include_metadata
params.description: Include metric metadata in each result.

params.name: start
params.description: Start timestamp for metric name search.

params.name: end
params.description: End timestamp for metric name search.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of metric names to return.

params.name: batch_size
params.description: Preferred number of results per NDJSON batch.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of metrics to return.

params.name: limit_per_metric
params.description: The maximum number of metadata entries per metric.

params.name: metric
params.description: A metric name to filter metadata for.
